source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 2 (PDF 22-45), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 2 (Atomic Structure) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Describe Moseley's observation that established the atomic number. Define nucleon number and show how the numbers of protons, neutrons and electrons are found for an atom and for its ions. (4 marks)
(Moseley ka woh mushahida bayan karein jis se atomic number saabit hua. Nucleon number ki definition likhein aur dikhayein ke atom aur us ke ions mein protons, neutrons aur electrons kaise maloom kiye jate hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Moseley ka mushahida (1913): jab mukhtalif elements par cathode rays dali gayin to khaas frequencies ki X-rays paida huin. In X-rays ki frequency ka square root atomic number Z ke barah-e-raast mutanasib tha:
√ν ∝ Z
Nateeja: atomic number Z element ki bunyadi khasiyat hai. Ise proton number bhi kehte hain.

Nucleon number: nucleus mein protons aur neutrons ki kul tadaad nucleon number (A) hai, ise mass number bhi kehte hain.
A = Z + N, is liye N = A − Z
Element X ke atom ke symbol ke baayen ooper A aur baayen neeche Z likhte hain, maslan ²⁷₁₃Al: Z = 13, A = 27, N = 27 − 13 = 14.

Ions: sirf electrons kam ya ziyada hote hain; protons aur neutrons wahi rehte hain.
• ²⁷₁₃Al teen electrons khota hai → Al³⁺: protons 13, neutrons 14, electrons 13 − 3 = 10.
• ³⁵₁₇Cl aik electron leta hai → Cl⁻: protons 17, neutrons 18, electrons 17 + 1 = 18.
• Table 2.1: O²⁻ (8 n, 8 p, 10 e), S²⁻ (16 n, 16 p, 18 e), P³⁻ (16 n, 15 p, 18 e).
Is tarah atomic number aur proton number aik hi cheez hain.

book_ref.quote: He concluded that this number, i.e. the atomic number Z was a fundamental property of an element.

blocks.prompt:
2 Calculate the numbers of protons, neutrons and electrons in each of the following: (i) ⁴⁰₂₀Ca²⁺ (ii) ¹⁹₉F⁻ (iii) ⁵⁶₂₆Fe²⁺ (iv) ⁷⁹₃₅Br⁻. (4 marks)
(In mein se har aik mein protons, neutrons aur electrons ki tadaad nikalein: (i) ⁴⁰₂₀Ca²⁺ (ii) ¹⁹₉F⁻ (iii) ⁵⁶₂₆Fe²⁺ (iv) ⁷⁹₃₅Br⁻.)
blocks.explanation: Protons = Z; neutrons = A − Z; electrons = Z minus positive charge, ya Z plus negative charge.

book_ref.quote: Number of neutrons in an atom can be calculated as

blocks.prompt:
3 Describe the behaviour of electrons, protons and neutrons in an electric field. How is the amount of deflection measured? (4 marks)
(Electric field mein electrons, protons aur neutrons ka rawaiyya bayan karein. Deflection ki miqdaar kaise naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Electric field mein zarraat ka rawaiyya un ke mass aur charge par munhasir hai. Jab electrons, protons aur neutrons ki beams aik aik kar ke aik hi speed se electric field se guzaarte hain (Figure 2.1):
• Neutrons neutral hain, nahi mudte aur field ki simt ke amoodan seedhe chalte hain.
• Protons positive hain, negative plate ki taraf mudte hain.
• Electrons negative hain, positive plate ki taraf ziyada mudte hain, kyunke un ka mass proton ka 1/1836 hai.

Deflection ki pemaish: asal simt se inhiraf (deviation) do tareeqon se naapa jata hai:
(i) Angle of deflection ∝ charge/mass
(ii) Radius of deflection ∝ mass/charge
Radius ke liye maana jata hai ke mudne ke baad zarra gol raste par chalta hai. Is liye radius par asar karne wale factors angle wale factors ka ulta hain: halke electron ka angle bara aur radius chhota; bhaari proton ka angle chhota aur radius bara.

book_ref.quote: The behaviour of particles in an electric field depends upon their mass and charge.

blocks.prompt:
4 Give the charges (in coulomb and relative) and masses (in kg and amu) of the three fundamental particles. Which particle is the heaviest and which the lightest? (4 marks)
(Teen bunyadi zarraat ke charge (coulomb aur relative) aur mass (kg aur amu) likhein. Kaun sa sab se bhaari aur kaun sa sab se halka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 2.2 electron, proton aur neutron ki khasiyaat deta hai. Neutron sab se bhaari (1.0087 amu) hai, proton (1.0073 amu) se thora bhaari; electron sab se halka (5.4858 × 10⁻⁴ amu) hai, proton ke mass ka taqreeban 1/1836. Proton aur electron par barabar aur mukhalif charge hai; neutron par koi charge nahi.

book_ref.quote: The Table (2.2) shows the properties of three fundamental particles

blocks.prompt:
5 Using the charges and masses in Table 2.2, calculate the charge-to-mass ratio of the electron and of the proton. How many times larger is the angle-of-deflection factor of the electron than that of the proton? (4 marks)
(Table 2.2 ke charge aur mass se electron aur proton ka charge/mass ratio nikalein. Electron ka angle-of-deflection factor proton ke muqable mein kitne guna bara hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angle of deflection ∝ charge/mass, is liye dono e/m qeematon ka muqabla karein.

book_ref.quote: Table 2.2 Properties of three fundamental particles

steps: Ratio = (1.759 × 10¹¹)/(9.579 × 10⁷) = 1836 (m_p/m_e ke barabar, kyunke charges ki miqdaar barabar hai).
Yani electron ka charge/mass, aur is liye angle-of-deflection factor, proton ka 1836 guna hai; us ka radius of deflection usi nisbat se chhota hai.
blocks.final_answer: e/m (electron) = 1.759 × 10¹¹ C kg⁻¹; e/m (proton) = 9.579 × 10⁷ C kg⁻¹; ratio = 1836.

blocks.prompt:
6 What are atomic emission and atomic absorption spectra? Explain why atomic spectra are called the finger prints of the elements. (4 marks)
(Atomic emission aur atomic absorption spectra kya hain? Wazahat karein ke atomic spectra ko elements ke finger prints kyun kehte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Atomic emission spectrum: jab gas halat ke element ko bohat garam kiya jaye ya us mein electrical discharge guzara jaye to khaas wavelengths ki radiation kharij hoti hai. Is radiation ke spectrum mein rangeen lakeerein hoti hain; ise atomic emission spectrum kehte hain (maslan hydrogen, Figure 2.2 (a)).

Atomic absorption spectrum: jab white light ki beam thandi halat ke gas element se guzari jaye to khaas wavelengths jazb ho jati hain. Jazb shuda wavelengths spectrum par kaali lakeeron ki soorat mein aati hain (Figure 2.2 (b)). Kaali lakeeron ki wavelengths bilkul emission spectrum ki rangeen lakeeron jaisi hain. (Hydrogen ki visible lakeerein 410, 434, 486 aur 656 nm par hain.)

Finger prints: har element ki electrons ki tarteeb munfarid hai, is liye us ke muqarrar energy levels bhi munfarid hain. Electrons ke aik level se doosre level par jump se jazb ya kharij hone wali radiation ki wavelengths aur frequencies bhi munfarid hongi. Is liye har element ka apna khaas spectrum hai aur usi se pehchana jata hai (Figure 2.3); yani atomic spectra elements ke finger prints hain.

book_ref.quote: Each element has a unique arrangement of electrons and thus a unique range of fixed energy levels.

blocks.prompt:
7 Explain how the first ionization energies of elements vary down a group and across a period, giving the reasons. Which elements have the lowest and highest values in each period? (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke elements ki first ionization energies group mein neeche aur period mein baayen se daayen kaise badalti hain, wajah ke saath. Har period mein sab se kam aur sab se ziyada qeemat kin elements ki hai?)
blocks.explanation:
First ionization energies ka atomic number ke muqable mein graph (Figure 2.5, pehle 88 elements) yeh batata hai:

1. Tamam ionization energies strongly endothermic hain: atom se electron alag karne mein energy lagti hai.

2. Group mein neeche (maslan He → Ne → Ar, ya Li → Na → K) ionization energies ghatti hain. Atom jitna bara, electron alag karna utna asaan. Group mein neeche shells barhte hain, nucleus ki valence electrons par giraft kam hoti hai aur electron nikalna asaan hota hai.

3. Period mein baayen se daayen ionization energies aam tor par barhti hain. Shell number wahi rehta hai; proton number barhta hai aur electrons usi shell mein aate hain, is liye nucleus valence electrons ko ziyada mazbooti se khenchta hai.

4. Har period mein group 1 (alkali metals) ki ionization energy sab se kam aur noble gases ki sab se ziyada hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The second way in which ionization energies show us the details of electronic configuration

blocks.prompt:
8 The first four successive ionization energies of an element Y are 496, 4562, 6910 and 9543 kJ mol⁻¹. Calculate the ratio of each ionization energy to the one before it, and deduce the number of electrons in the outermost shell of Y and its group. (4 marks)
(Element Y ki pehli chaar successive ionization energies 496, 4562, 6910 aur 9543 kJ mol⁻¹ hain. Har ionization energy ka pichhli se ratio nikalein, aur Y ke sab se bahar wale shell ke electrons aur us ka group maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Bohat bara jump batata hai ke agla electron andar ke shell se, nucleus ke qareeb se, nikal raha hai; jump se pehle nikalne wale electrons ginein.

book_ref.quote: The successive ionization energies show clearly the arrangement of electrons in shells around the nucleus.

steps: Sirf pehli aur doosri ionization energy ke darmiyan bara jump hai, is liye bahar wale shell mein sirf aik electron hai; doosra andar ke shell se nikalta hai. Aik valence electron: group 1 (alkali metal).
blocks.final_answer: Ratios 9.20, 1.51, 1.38; Y ka 1 valence electron hai aur woh group 1 mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
9 Describe the azimuthal quantum number. Give its values for n = 1 to 4, the subshells they represent and the number of electrons each subshell can hold. (4 marks)
(Azimuthal quantum number bayan karein. n = 1 se 4 tak is ki qeematein, un se banne wale subshells aur har subshell mein electrons ki gunjaish batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Azimuthal (angular momentum) quantum number ℓ ki har n ke liye 0 se (n − 1) tak integral qeematein hoti hain. Yeh orbital ki shape batata hai.
• n = 1: sirf ℓ = 0
• n = 2: ℓ = 0 aur 1
• n = 3: ℓ = 0, 1 aur 2
• n = 4: ℓ = 0, 1, 2 aur 3
ℓ = 0, 1, 2, 3 ko s, p, d, f (sharp, principal, diffused, fundamental) kehte hain; yeh spectral lakeeron ki khasiyaat ke spectral terms hain.

Subshell: aik jaise n aur ℓ wale orbitals ka set. Shell mein subshells ki tadaad shell number ke barabar hai (K: 1s; L: 2s, 2p; M: 3s, 3p, 3d; N: 4s, 4p, 4d, 4f).
Subshell mein electrons = 2(2ℓ + 1):

book_ref.quote: The values of ‘ℓ’ are integers that depend on the value of the principal quantum number.

blocks.prompt:
10 For the N shell (n = 4), calculate (i) the number of subshells, (ii) the number of orbitals in each subshell and in the shell, and (iii) the maximum number of electrons in each subshell and in the shell. Show that the total agrees with 2n². (4 marks)
(N shell (n = 4) ke liye nikalein: (i) subshells ki tadaad, (ii) har subshell aur poore shell mein orbitals, (iii) har subshell aur poore shell mein ziyada se ziyada electrons. Dikhayein ke kul 2n² ke barabar hai.)
blocks.explanation: Subshells = n; subshell mein orbitals = 2ℓ + 1; subshell mein electrons = 2(2ℓ + 1); shell ka kul = 2n².

book_ref.quote: The number of subshells in a shell is equal to its shell number.

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain the magnetic quantum number. Give its values for the s, p, d and f subshells and explain the term degenerate orbitals. (4 marks)
(Magnetic quantum number ki wazahat karein. s, p, d aur f subshells ke liye is ki qeematein dein aur degenerate orbitals ki istilah samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Magnetic quantum number m space mein orbital ka rukh (orientation) batata hai. Subshell ke andar m ℓ par munhasir hai: ℓ ki kisi qeemat ke liye m ki (2ℓ + 1) integral qeematein hain, −ℓ se 0 se +ℓ tak. m ki qeematein subshell mein orbitals ki tadaad batati hain.

Degenerate orbitals: aik hi subshell ke orbitals ki energy barabar hoti hai; inhein degenerate orbitals kehte hain. Yeh magnetic field ki mojoodgi mein aik doosre se alag pehchane jate hain, isi liye naam magnetic quantum number hai. Magnetic field mein bareek spectral lakeeron ka batna subshells mein orbitals ki mojoodgi ki nishani hai.

book_ref.quote: Within a subshell, the value of m depends on the value of ℓ.

blocks.prompt:
12 Explain the spin quantum number. State Pauli's exclusion principle and apply it to the two electrons of a helium atom. (4 marks)
(Spin quantum number ki wazahat karein. Pauli's exclusion principle bayan karein aur helium atom ke do electrons par lagayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Spin quantum number: electrons ko apne mehwar par ghoomta hua samjha jata hai, jaise zameen. Electromagnetic theory ke mutabiq ghoomta charge magnetic field paida karta hai, is liye electron magnet jaisa hai. Do mumkina spin hain, clockwise aur anticlockwise (Figure 2.8). Spin ko shamil karne ke liye chautha quantum number, spin quantum number s, rakha gaya. Is ki qeematein +½ (clockwise, arrow ↑) aur −½ (anticlockwise, arrow ↓) hain.
Har orbital mein ziyada se ziyada do electrons aa sakte hain, bashart-e-ke un ke spin mukhalif hon. Teen quantum numbers orbital bayan karte hain; chautha us ke do electrons mein farq karta hai.

Pauli's exclusion principle: atom mein koi do electrons chaaron quantum numbers ki aik jaisi qeematein nahi rakh sakte; yani aik orbital ke do electrons ke spin hamesha mukhalif hote hain.

Helium: is ke do electrons 1s orbital mein hain:
Electron 1: n = 1, ℓ = 0, m = 0, s = +½ (clockwise)
Electron 2: n = 1, ℓ = 0, m = 0, s = −½ (anticlockwise)
In ke n, ℓ aur m aik jaise magar s mukhtalif hai, yani spin mukhalif hain.

book_ref.quote: To take the electron spin into account, it is necessary to introduce a fourth quantum number

blocks.prompt:
13 Define an atomic orbital. Describe the shapes of the s and p orbitals. (4 marks)
(Atomic orbital ki definition likhein. s aur p orbitals ki shakalein bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Atomic orbital: nucleus ke gird space ka woh teen simti ilaqa jahan electron ke milne ka imkaan sab se ziyada ho.

s orbital (ℓ = 0): shakal gol (spherical) hai. Nucleus ke gird electron density har simt mein yaksaan hai. Principal quantum number barhne se s orbital bara hota hai; 2s ki boundary surface 1s se bari hai. s subshell mein sirf aik orbital (m = 0) hai.

p orbitals (ℓ = 1): 2p orbital ki electron density s orbital ki tarah spherically symmetric nahi. p orbital ke aik axis par do lobes hain (dumbbell shakal). Teen p orbitals hain (m = −1, 0, +1), jin ke naam un ke axes ke mutabiq px, py aur pz hain (Figure 2.6). Subshell ke teen p orbitals degenerate hain.

book_ref.quote: An atomic orbital is defined as the three dimensional region in space around the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
14 Describe the shapes and orientations of the five d orbitals. What does the chapter say about the f orbitals? (4 marks)
(Paanch d orbitals ki shakalein aur rukh bayan karein. Chapter f orbitals ke bare mein kya kehta hai?)
blocks.explanation:
d orbitals (ℓ = 2): m = −2, −1, 0, +1, +2, is liye paanch d orbitals hain. Kisi shell mein in ki shakalein aur rukh mukhtalif hain (Figure 2.7, paanch 3d orbitals); aam shakal cloverleaf (double dumbbell) hai.
• dxy xy plane mein hai.
• dxz xz plane mein hai.
• dyz yz plane mein hai.
• dx²−y²: is ke lobes x aur y axes par hain.
• dz²: z-axis par do lobes aur xy plane mein aik 'doughnut'.
Subshell ke paanch d orbitals degenerate hain aur 10 electrons rakhte hain.

f orbitals (ℓ = 3): f subshell ke space mein saat rukh (m = −3 se +3) hain, yani saat f orbitals jo 14 electrons rakhte hain. In ki shakalein bohat pecheeda hain.

book_ref.quote: The shapes for the five d orbitals

blocks.prompt:
15 What is electronic configuration? Explain how it is written in shells, in subshell notation and as an orbital diagram, with examples. (4 marks)
(Electronic configuration kya hai? Wazahat karein ke yeh shells, subshell notation aur orbital diagram ki soorat mein kaise likhi jati hai, misalon ke saath.)
blocks.explanation:
Electronic configuration atom ya ion ke mojood shells, subshells ya orbitals mein electrons ki taqseem hai.

Shells mein: shells K, L, M, N … n = 1, 2, 3, 4 … ke mutabiq hain, gunjaish K 2 (1s), L 8 (2s, 2p), M 18 (3s, 3p, 3d) aur N 32 (4s, 4p, 4d, 4f). Maslan H: 1s¹ (K shell); He: 1s² (K shell); Na: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s¹ (K, L aur M shells).

Subshell notation: subshell symbols aik ke baad aik likhe jate hain, har aik ke daayen superscript us subshell ke electrons batata hai. Maslan ⁹₄Be, jis ke 1s mein do aur 2s mein do electrons hain, 1s²2s² likha jata hai.

Orbital diagram: orbitals ke har group par subshell notation likha jata hai aur har electron arrow se dikhaya jata hai, s = +½ ke liye ooper aur s = −½ ke liye neeche. Maslan boron (¹¹₅B): 1s ↑↓, 2s ↑↓, 2p ↑ _ _.

book_ref.quote: In case of subshells, the electronic configuration is described by a notation

blocks.prompt:
16 State the Aufbau principle. Explain the (n + ℓ) rule for arranging subshells in order of energy, with examples. (4 marks)
(Aufbau principle bayan karein. Subshells ko energy ki tarteeb mein rakhne ka (n + ℓ) rule misalon ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Aufbau (building up) principle: atom ke subshells energy ki barhti tarteeb mein electrons se bharte hain.

(n + ℓ) rule: magnetic field na ho to subshell ki energy n aur ℓ par munhasir hai, is liye bharne ki tarteeb (n + ℓ) se milti hai:
1. Kam (n + ℓ) wale subshell ki energy kam hai aur woh pehle bharta hai. Maslan 4s: 4 + 0 = 4; 3d: 3 + 2 = 5; is liye 4s 3d se pehle.
2. Agar do subshells ki (n + ℓ) barabar ho to kam n wala pehle bharta hai. Maslan 4p: 4 + 1 = 5 aur 3d: 3 + 2 = 5; kam n ki wajah se 3d pehle.

Natija tarteeb:
1s < 2s < 2p < 3s < 3p < 4s < 3d < 4p < 5s < 4d < 5p < 6s < 4f < 5d < 6p < 7s

book_ref.quote: Now, question arises that how to arrange the subshells energy wise.

blocks.prompt:
17 Calculate the (n + ℓ) values of the subshells 5d, 6s, 4f, 5p, 4d and 5s, and arrange them in the order in which they are filled. (4 marks)
(Subshells 5d, 6s, 4f, 5p, 4d aur 5s ki (n + ℓ) qeematein nikalein aur unhein bharne ki tarteeb mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Kam (n + ℓ) pehle bharta hai; barabar (n + ℓ) mein kam n pehle (s: ℓ = 0, p: 1, d: 2, f: 3).

book_ref.quote: hence the order of filling subshells with electrons may be obtained from the summation

steps: Sab se kam: 5s (5) pehle bharta hai.

blocks.prompt:
18 State Hund's rule. Explain it with the filling of three electrons in the 2p orbitals and with the configurations of carbon, nitrogen and oxygen. (4 marks)
(Hund's rule bayan karein. Teen electrons ke 2p orbitals mein bharne aur carbon, nitrogen aur oxygen ki configurations se is ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hund's rule barabar energy wale (degenerate) orbitals, maslan px, py aur pz, mein electrons bharne ka tareeqa batata hai. Jab degenerate orbitals mojood hon to electrons aik hi orbital mein mukhalif spin se jaane ke bajaye alag orbitals mein aik jaise spin se rakhe jate hain.

Teen electrons teen p orbitals mein: (I) do aik orbital mein joda bana kar aur aik doosre mein, ya (II) px, py aur pz mein aik aik, aik jaise spin se. Hund's rule ke mutabiq (II) sahih hai: har orbital mein aik electron.

Wajah: aik hi jagah ke electrons aik jaisa charge hone ki wajah se aik doosre ko dhakelte hain, is liye repulsion kam karne ke liye subshell ke alag orbitals mein jate hain; joda tab banta hai jab koi khali orbital na bache.

Misalein (Figure 2.14):
• Carbon 1s² 2s² 2p²: 2p ↑ ↑ _ → 2 unpaired electrons
• Nitrogen 1s² 2s² 2p³: 2p ↑ ↑ ↑ → 3 unpaired electrons
• Oxygen 1s² 2s² 2p⁴: 2p ↑↓ ↑ ↑ → har 2p orbital mein aik electron ke baad hi joda banta hai; 2 unpaired electrons

book_ref.quote: Which of the two is correct? The answer is given by Hund’s rule

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Hund's rule ka seedha matlab: aik subshell ke barabar energy wale orbitals mein pehle har orbital mein aik aik electron (aik jaise spin) jata hai, phir jodey bante hain. Isi liye carbon ke do 2p electrons do alag orbitals mein hain.

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain how electronic configurations are represented by electrons-in-boxes diagrams, taking boron as an example. Write the configurations of chromium and copper from Table 2.7. (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke electronic configurations electrons-in-boxes diagrams se kaise dikhayi jati hain, boron ki misaal se. Table 2.7 se chromium aur copper ki configurations likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Electrons-in-boxes diagram (Figure 2.13):
• Har box aik atomic orbital hai.
• Boxes (orbitals) neeche se ooper energy ki barhti tarteeb mein rakhe jate hain.
• Electron arrow se dikhaya jata hai; arrow ki simt us ka spin batati hai.
• Orbital mein do electrons hon to un ke spin mukhalif hote hain, is liye us box ke do arrows mukhalif simt mein hote hain.
• Aik subshell ke electrons jahan mumkin ho alag orbitals mein aik jaise spin se jate hain taake repulsion kam ho; joda tab banta hai jab koi khali orbital na bache.

Boron (Z = 5), 1s² 2s² 2p¹: sab se neeche 1s ↑↓; us ke ooper 2s ↑↓; ooper teen 2p boxes ki row, pehle mein aik arrow ↑ aur do khali.

Table 2.7 (Z = 1–36) se:
• Chromium (Z = 24): 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁵4s¹
• Copper (Z = 29): 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d¹⁰4s¹

book_ref.quote: A useful way of representing electronic configurations is a diagram that places electrons in boxes

blocks.prompt:
20 Explain how the electronic configurations of elements are related to their positions in the periodic table (s, p, d and f blocks). (4 marks)
(Wazahat karein ke elements ki electronic configurations ka periodic table mein un ki jagah (s, p, d aur f blocks) se kya taluq hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Periodic table aise banaya gaya hai ke aik jaisi bahar wali (valence) configuration wale elements aik group mein hon; element ki jagah se us ki configuration likhi ja sakti hai (Figure 2.15). Elements bharne wale orbital ki qisam se group kiye jate hain:
• s-block: baayen taraf do columns, alkali metals (group 1, ns¹) aur alkaline earth metals (group 2, ns²); bahar ke s orbitals bhar rahe hain.
• p-block: daayen taraf chhe columns ka block, jahan sab se bahar ke p orbitals bhar rahe hain; group 13 = ns²np¹.
• d-block: beech mein das columns ka block, transition metals, jahan d orbitals bhar rahe hain.
• f-block: main table ke neeche chaudah columns ki do rows, jahan f orbitals bhar rahe hain.
Numbers 2, 6, 10 aur 14 bilkul s, p, d aur f subshells ki electrons ki gunjaish hain.

book_ref.quote: Notice that the elements can be grouped in terms of the type of orbital into which the electrons are placed.

blocks.prompt:
21 What are valence electrons? Explain the classification of elements into representative, d-block transition and f-block inner-transition elements, and the building-up order across the periods. (4 marks)
(Valence electrons kya hain? Elements ki representative, d-block transition aur f-block inner-transition elements mein taqseem aur periods mein building-up order ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Valence electrons atom ke sab se bahar wale shell ke electrons hain. Yahi chemical reactions mein hissa lete hain, aur valence configurations ki mushabehat group ke elements ki chemical properties ki mushabehat ki wajah hai.

Taqseem (Figure 2.16):
• Main-group (representative) elements ki valence-shell configuration nsᵃ npᵇ hai: bahar wala s ya p subshell bhar raha hai (neela hissa: ns; hara hissa: np).
• d-block transition elements: d subshell, (n − 1)d, bhar raha hai (peela hissa).
• f-block inner-transition elements: f subshell, (n − 2)f, bhar raha hai (halka sunehra hissa).

Building-up order: period 1 mein 1s; period 2 mein 2s phir aage ja kar 2p; period 3 mein 3s aur 3p; period 4 mein 4s, 3d phir 4p.

Elements ki metals, non-metals, representative aur transition elements, periods, groups aur blocks (s, p, d, f) mein taqseem electronic configuration aur valence electrons ki buniyaad par hai, is liye un ki chemical properties asaani se samjhi ja sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: There is a definite pattern to the order of filling of the subshells

blocks.prompt:
22 Explain how the electronic configurations of positive and negative ions are written. How do the d-block elements behave differently? Give examples. (4 marks)
(Positive aur negative ions ki electronic configurations kaise likhi jati hain, wazahat karein. d-block elements mukhtalif kaise hain? Misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Positive ions atoms se electrons nikalne par bante hain. Maslan Na⁺ (proton number 11) mein 10 electrons: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶, neon jaisi.

Negative ions atoms ke electrons lene par bante hain. Maslan S²⁻ (proton number 16) mein 18 electrons: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶, argon jaisi.

Aam tor par metal atoms positive ion banate waqt bahar wale subshell se electrons khote hain.

d-block elements: potassium se zinc tak 4s subshell 3d se pehle bharta hai, magar d-block atom ion banate waqt pehle 4s ke electrons khota hai:
• Ti atom: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d² 4s² → Ti²⁺: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d²
• Cr atom: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d⁵ 4s¹ → Cr³⁺: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d³

book_ref.quote: Note that, in general, electrons in the outer subshell are removed when metal atoms form the positive ions.

blocks.prompt:
23 Iron has Z = 26 (Fe: 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁶4s² in Table 2.7). Write the configurations of Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺ and find the number of unpaired electrons in Fe, Fe²⁺ and Fe³⁺. (4 marks)
(Iron ka Z = 26 hai (Table 2.7 mein Fe: 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁶4s²). Fe²⁺ aur Fe³⁺ ki configurations likhein aur Fe, Fe²⁺ aur Fe³⁺ mein unpaired electrons ki tadaad nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehle 4s ke electrons nikalein, phir 3d ke; paanch 3d orbitals mein pehle aik aik electron, phir joda (Hund's rule).

book_ref.quote: Reading across the Periodic Table from potassium to zinc, the 4s subshell fills before the 3d subshell.

steps: Fe²⁺ (26 − 2 = 24 electrons): dono 4s electrons nikalte hain → 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁶.
Fe³⁺ (26 − 3 = 23 electrons): do 4s aur aik 3d electron nikalte hain → 1s²2s²2p⁶3s²3p⁶3d⁵.
3d⁶: paanch orbitals mein aik aik, chhata electron aik mein joda: ↑↓ ↑ ↑ ↑ ↑ → 4 unpaired (Fe aur Fe²⁺ dono 3d⁶; Fe ka 4s² paired hai).
blocks.final_answer: Fe²⁺: …3d⁶; Fe³⁺: …3d⁵. Unpaired electrons: Fe 4, Fe²⁺ 4, Fe³⁺ 5.

blocks.prompt:
24 What is a free radical? Explain, with the electronic configuration of chlorine, why a free chlorine atom is a free radical, and give examples of free radicals made of groups of atoms. (4 marks)
(Free radical kya hai? Chlorine ki electronic configuration se wazahat karein ke azad chlorine atom free radical kyun hai, aur atoms ke groups se bane free radicals ki misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation:
Free radical: aisa species jis mein aik ya ziyada unpaired electrons hon.

Chlorine atom Cl•: configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁵. 2p subshell poora bhara (2p⁶) hai. 3p subshell mein teen orbitals mein paanch electrons hain: do orbitals mein jode hain jabke teesre mein aik akela unpaired electron hai (3p: ↑↓ ↑↓ ↑). Is unpaired electron ki wajah se azad chlorine atom free radical hai. Unpaired electron aik nuqte se dikhaya jata hai, jaise Cl•.

Atoms ke groups: akele atoms ke ilawa atoms ke groups bhi free radicals ho sakte hain, maslan OH• aur CH₃•.

book_ref.quote: An example of a simple free radical is free chlorine atom

blocks.prompt:
25 What are semiconductors? Explain, on the basis of electronic configuration, why pure silicon does not conduct, and how doping produces P-type and N-type semiconductors. (4 marks)
(Semiconductors kya hain? Electronic configuration ki buniyaad par wazahat karein ke khalis silicon kyun conduct nahi karta, aur doping se P-type aur N-type semiconductors kaise bante hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Semiconductors aise materials hain jo kuch halaat mein bijli guzar sakte hain. Yeh smartphones, laptops aur cars samait bohat se electronic devices mein istemal hote hain. Silicon, germanium aur arsenic aise elements ki misalein hain; yeh un ki khaas electronic configuration ki wajah se mumkin hai.

Khalis silicon: ₁₄Si = 2, 8, 4, yani valence shell mein 4 electrons. Khalis crystal mein har Si atom chaar doosre Si atoms se bandha hai (Figure 2.17), is liye crystal mein electronic conduction ka koi imkaan nahi.

Doping: khalis semiconductor mein impurity atoms mila kar P-type aur N-type semiconductors banaye jate hain:
• Trivalent impurities (boron ya aluminium) se P-type; impurity lattice mein holes (positive charge carriers) banati hai.
• Pentavalent impurities (phosphorus ya arsenic) se N-type; impurity extra electrons (negative charge carriers) deti hai.

book_ref.quote: Let us consider the example of Si and explore how it can be converted into a p-type and n-type semiconductors.

blocks.prompt:
26 Describe the formation of P-type and N-type semiconductors from silicon and explain how each conducts electricity. (4 marks)
(Silicon se P-type aur N-type semiconductors ke banne ka tareeqa bayan karein aur samjhayein ke har aik bijli kaise guzarta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
P-type semiconductor: teen valence electrons wale impurity atoms (maslan Al) khalis silicon mein milaye jate hain. Kuch trivalent atoms crystal mein Si atoms ki jagah le lete hain. Electrons ki kami ki wajah se silicon atoms chaar bonds nahi bana sakte, is liye crystal lattice mein holes bante hain jo positive charge carriers hain (Figure 2.18). Is se positive-type yani P-type semiconductor banta hai. Bahar ke current source se electrons is mein harkat kar sakte hain, is liye yeh conductor ka kaam karta hai.

N-type semiconductor: paanch valence electrons wale impurity atoms (maslan phosphorus) milaye jate hain; kuch Si atoms ki jagah pentavalent phosphorus atoms aa jate hain. Qareeb ke Si atoms chaar bonds bana lete hain aur paanchwan electron extra hota hai. Yeh impurity atoms crystal lattice ko extra electrons dete hain jo harkat ke liye azad hain aur negative charge carriers ka kaam karte hain (Figure 2.18). Nateeja N-type semiconductor hai jo bahar ke source se jorne par bijli guzarta hai.
